verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM, managed from the compliance dashboard. Admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture, enforce settings, and apply a secure macOS/Windows baseline. However, the evidence never names the specific checks in the story or ties posture to individual employees. missing for 10: explicit disk-encryption and screen-lock posture checks, password-manager detection, per-employee compliance mapping/reporting, third-party MDM integration, independent or hands-on corroboration
